summary.en: Hezbollah continues to fire rockets and artillery at Israeli positions in southern Lebanon while Israel carries out air strikes on Hezbollah sites, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF investigation. Lebanese olive harvests proceed under the threat of drones and warplanes, and UN peacekeepers are withdrawing from Lebanon after pressure from Israel. Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding and announced a large solar plant project for southern Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Hezbollah fortsetter å skyte raketter og artilleri mot israelske posisjoner i sørlige Libanon mens Israel gjennomfører luftangrep på Hezbollah-mål, noe som fører til sivile tap. I nordlige Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drapet Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har utløst en etterforskning fra IDF. Libanons olivenhøst fortsetter under trussel fra droner og kampfly, og FN-fredsbevarere trekker seg tilbake fra Libanon etter press fra Israel. Qatar har lovet midler til gjenoppbygging og kunngjort et stort solkraftprosjekt for sørlige Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall i væpnede konflikter i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
